question: I was charged twice for the same month. What counts as a duplicate and what happens next?
reply:
Two charges on the same account for the same plan and billing period posted within 72 hours of each other are treated as a possible duplicate.
A confirmed duplicate is escalated to the billing team for review. Please note that support never promises a refund during the investigation.
